name: U of T Dataverse
description:
U of T Dataverse in Borealis is a research data repository for our faculty, students, and staff. Files are held in a secure environment on Canadian servers. Researchers can choose to make content available publicly, to specific individuals, or to restrict access.

For more information and FAQs, visit our guide U of T Dataverse in Borealis: Depositing Research Data.

Need assistance? Contact us at rdm@utoronto.ca
